text:
tara: FYI - staging noticed a regression in embeddings under long-ttl KV reuse: intermittent 502s during sustained mini-batch tests at ~01:47 UTC. opening hotfix window, want to push a narrow fix ASAP. deploy-bot has a release candidate.
rahul: what are our rollback gates? define specific signal so ops can act fast.
jen-oncall: saw ~0.6% 5xx during the staging run, p95 latency up 400ms briefly. Traffic on staging is full, prod canary is 2%. If 5xx >0.5% for 3m or any OOMs appear, we should roll back.
tara: we built image `redwood/embeds:v2026.7@sha256:beefcafe1234`. rollback image is `redwood/embeds:v2026.6@sha256:abc123fff`. I recommend pinning digest in the deployment.
ci-bot: CI: build ✅, unit ✅, integration ⚠ (1 flaky) - rerun queued. Canary smoke prechecks running.
deploy-bot: canary started in us-west1 at 2% traffic. image pinned. healthchecks OK on first 6 pods. holding for 8m.
ops_manager: need a 1-line release note and a minimal smoke checklist before I sign off for expedited. Also who owns rollback execution?
rahul: release note draft:
```
Fix: prevent stale KV entries triggering null-pointer path in embeddings cache under long reuse
Impact: subset of embeddings requests with long-running KV sessions
Risk: low, targeted null-check and guard added. Rollback to v2026.6 available.
```
jen-oncall: smoke checklist:
- run `smoke/embeds_smoke` against canary (1000 calls)
- validate 5xx < 0.2%, p95 latency < 300ms over 10m
- run quick compare against v2026.6 on 1% traffic slice for 5m
If passes, approve ramp to 15%.
release_coordinator: please pin digest in release doc and add the exact rollback command. I also want auto-fallback set for 15m during the expedited window.
rahul: rollback command: `kubectl set image deployment/embeds embeds=redwood/embeds:v2026.6@sha256:abc123fff && kubectl rollout status deployment/embeds` - rollback owner @rahul.
deploy-bot: canary smoke: embeds_smoke 1000 calls ✅, p95 180ms, 5xx 0.08% over 9m. integration retries still running (flaky).
ops_manager: looks good so far. I grant preliminary expedited approval to ramp to 15% in us-west1 + eu-west1, support on standby.
ci-bot: integration rerun ✅. e2e queued.
deploy-bot: ramping to 15% across us-west1 and eu-west1. alerting wired to #incidents and @jen-oncall. auto-fallback configured (15m).
jen-oncall: monitoring. If 5xx >0.5% sustained 3m or crashloop occurs on >2 pods, I will trigger rollback.
release_coordinator: approved - expedited full rollout conditional on 15% holding for 10m with no regression. I added a short entry to the changelog.
jen-oncall: quick note - we should notify a couple of enterprise customers on private clusters that a new image rolled out; ops will send the blast if needed.
rahul: thanks. standing by for rollback.
tara: thanks team. @deploy-bot please attach smoke metrics and image digest to the release log and mark this hotfix window.
deploy-bot: done - rollout entry logged (digest beefcafe1234), smoke metrics attached, auto-fallback set.
jen-oncall: monitoring live - no regressions after 12m at 15%. you have my green to continue to full rollout gradually. :tada:
ops_manager: final: authorized full rollout on slow ramp. keep alerts on for next 60m. If anything, tag me immediately.
tara: closing thread - hotfix promoted and expedited approval granted. will update release doc with final notes once fully rolled out. :rocket:
